scripts.dev:backend: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace=backend
scripts.dev:frontend: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace=frontend
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,yellow "npm run dev --workspace=backend" "npm run dev --workspace=frontend"
scripts.build:backend: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=backend
scripts.build:frontend: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=frontend
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=backend && npm run build --workspace=frontend
scripts.typecheck:backend: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=backend
scripts.typecheck:frontend: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=backend && npm run typecheck --workspace=frontend
scripts.test:backend: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspace=backend
scripts.test:frontend: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspace=frontend
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspace=backend && npm run test --workspace=frontend
